image_description: A low-angle shot of a large, ornate wooden pipe organ installed in an architectural setting. The organ features a central facade of tall, vertical metallic pipes flanked by shorter pipes on either side, all housed within a carved wooden case with decorative moldings. Below the pipes is a wooden console structure, though the specific keyboards and pedalboard are obscured by shadow and angle. Blue curtains frame the sides of the instrument.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The reflections on the metallic pipes appear slightly smeared and lack the crisp, high-frequency specular highlights expected of polished metal, suggesting minor texture synthesis issues.
The connection points where the pipes meet the wooden base are somewhat indistinct and 'mushy,' lacking clear mechanical definition or mounting hardware.
Slight warping in the straight lines of the wooden casing, particularly on the left side, which may indicate minor geometric instability.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific taxonomic classification of the instrument as a pipe organ and rule out look-alike structures.
To verify the 3D spatial relationship between the pipes and the wooden case, ensuring no floating elements or depth bleeding.
To check for fusion artifacts between adjacent pipes and ensure each pipe is a distinct, continuous object.
To assess the realism of materials (wood grain vs. metal) and identify any subtle generative noise or blur.

focus_areas: Specular reflection consistency on metal pipes
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the base of the pipes where they enter the wooden structure; AI often fails to render the mechanical mounting correctly. Also, scrutinize the reflections on the metal pipes for logical consistency with the light source.
